div.h2: Record live, replay with no model
div.p: Live needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with tool calling. Without one, replay the six committed runs.

svg.aria-label: A live run writes a record holding every inference's snapshot, trace and payload, the model's decision and each call's verdict. Replay re-assembles each snapshot and compares bytes, with no model.

g.text: uv run agent.py --live --user u_ada --record runs/live-01.json "Is there an incident…"
each call's verdict from the guard
the six scenarios under scenarios/ are such records, made with scripted models
Re-assembles every snapshot and compares the bytes. No model, so CI can run it.
CHECKPOINT 5 · one recorded run replayed, or the six committed runs and one surprising decision noted.
